question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Latent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Manifest)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"latent"** means something that is existing but not yet developed or manifest; hidden or concealed. (अव्यक्त)

 
 
• **Example: **She has a latent talent for drawing that she has not yet explored.
 
 
 
• **"Manifest"** means clear or obvious to the eye or mind. (प्रत्यक्ष)
 
 
• **Example: **His happiness was manifest in the wide smile on his face.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"latent"** is **"manifest"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Manifest)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Punctual** (समय पर): Happening or doing something at the agreed or proper time.

 
 
• **Example:** She is always punctual for her meetings.
 
 
 
• **Antique** (प्राचीन): A collectible object such as a piece of furniture or work of art that has a high value because of its considerable age.
 
 
• **Example: **They bought an antique clock from the auction.
 
 
 
• **Early** (जल्दी): Happening or done before the usual or expected time.
 
 
• **Example:** He arrived early for the event.
